Manulife This Cover Page is an important document. - It highlights the key features and risks of this product and should be read together with the Policy Illustration, Product Summary and Bundled Product Disclosure Document, where applicable. - It is important to read the Policy Illustration, Product Summary and Bundled Product Disclosure Document, where applicable, before deciding whether to purchase this product. If you do not have a copy of these documents, please contact us at 6737 1221 or your Financial Adviser Representative to ask for them. - You should not purchase this product if you do not understand or are not comfortable with the risks of this product. WHAT ARE YOU PURCHASING? This is a non-participating flexible premium universal life plan. It is a product which offers you insurance coverage and also invests part of your premiums in the insurer's Non-participating Fund. It comprises guaranteed and non-guaranteed benefits and may not be suitable for you if you want all benefits to be guaranteed. WHAT ARE THE KEY RISKS OF A UNIVERSAL LIFE PLAN? By purchasing a universal life plan, your premiums will be pooled together and invested with premiums from other policyholders in the Non-participating Fund managed by Manulife (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.. As a policyholder, the key risks commonly associated with universal life plan are:
Investment RisksLower than expected investment returns earned by the fund.
Insurance RisksHigher than expected claims made by policyholders (e.g. due to death or other terminations).
Expense RisksHigher than expected expenses incurred for managing the Non-participating Fund.
Currency RisksIf your home currency is not denominated in the Policy Currency, the payments you make or receive may be worth less over time when expressed in your home currency.
These risks can affect the crediting rate to be declared to and the charges to be deducted from the policy, which in turn affect the accumulation value (policy value). Your policy will lapse if the accumulation value (policy value) is insufficient to pay for the charges. In order to keep your policy in force, you may need to pay additional premium(s). ARE THE UNIVERSAL LIFE ILLUSTRATED CREDITING RATES GUARANTEED? The Policy Illustration shows two crediting rates – current and guaranteed crediting rates. Current crediting rate is not guaranteed and may increase or decrease after the guaranteed period, subject to the guaranteed crediting rate as a minimum floor. Current crediting rate for Fixed Account is 4.20% p.a.. The guaranteed crediting rate is guaranteed by the company. ARE THE UNIVERSAL LIFE ILLUSTRATED CHARGES GUARANTEED? The Policy Illustration shows two charges – current and maximum charges. Some charges may increase or decrease after the guaranteed period. Should the charges be increased from their current level, a larger deduction will be made and this will impact the accumulation value (policy value) of your policy. We may adjust the charges according to factors such as the expected future claims and expenses. However, the charges will never exceed the maximum level stated in your Policy Contract. You may refer to the Product Summary for the details of the current and maximum charges for the policy. Mr Customer Date UOB Date This illustration is only valid when all pages are included. CONFIDENTIAL Page 1 of 2 AWS / Version 96.4 / P E.&O.E. COVER PAGE FOR NON-PARTICIPATING UNIVERSAL LIFE PLAN

This policy is protected under the Policy Owners' Protection Scheme which is administered by the Singapore Deposit Insurance Corporation (SDIC). Coverage for your policy is automatic and no further action is required from you. For more information on the types of benefits that are covered under the scheme as well as the limits of coverage, where applicable, please contact us or visit the Life Insurance Association (LIA) or SDIC websites (www.lia.org.sg or www.sdic.org.sg).

Policy Issue Date is the date when the policy is issued and Policy Effective Date is the date when the policy coverage starts.

For the purpose of this Policy Illustration, the estimated Policy Issue Date reflects the date when all initial premiums have been received, the policy is issued and interest begins to be credited to the Fixed Account. If all premiums are not received by the date selected, the policy values may differ from that which is illustrated in this Policy Illustration.

For policies that are backdated, the Policy Effective Date will be earlier than the Policy Issue Date, and monthly charges will be effected from the requested Policy Effective Date. We will credit interest to the Fixed Account from the Policy Issue Date, regardless of any policy backdating. If the policy does not take effect on the date selected, the policy values may differ from that which is illustrated in this Policy Illustration.

Provided that the Early Lapse Protection Cumulative Premium Test is met, the policy provides an Early Lapse Protection feature that prevents the policy from lapse during the first 5 policy years (may end earlier once there is a change in life insured). Refer to Product Summary for further details.

Reduction of the Face Amount may cause the cumulative premium requirement to be recalculated, thus affecting the Early Lapse Protection feature.

Premiums received less the Premium Charge (Net Premiums) will be allocated into the Fixed Account and Index Account according to the Net Premium Allocation above. Net Premiums allocated to the Index Account will be further allocated to the Index Sub-accounts according to the Index Account Composition. ## Fixed Account Current crediting rate for the Fixed Account is 4.20% p.a.. For purposes of this Policy Illustration, the current assumed crediting rate for the Fixed Account is 4.20% p.a. and the guaranteed crediting rate for the Fixed Account is 2.00% p.a. with interest credited monthly into your Fixed Account. ## Index Account The Net Premiums allocated into this account (as per Net Premium Allocation) will be further allocated into Index Sub-accounts according to the selected Index Account Composition above. ## How is actual crediting interest for the Index Sub-accounts calculated? Interest for each Index Sub-account is calculated and credited into your Index Account annually using the concept of a “1-year Segment” for your policy. A 1-year Segment will commence on each $16^{\text{th}}$ day of the calendar month following your Policy Issue Date (Segment Initiation Date) for each Index Sub-account. Actual crediting interest will only be determined on the last calendar day of that 1-year Segment (Segment Maturity Date), based on the performance of underlying index multiplied by the relevant segment participation rate, subject to the guaranteed segment floor rate and the relevant segment cap rate. The cap rate may change from one Segment to another. We will inform you if the cap rate is changed, and any change will only apply to the new Segment created after the date of change. Specifically for the S&P PRISM index sub-account, the segment participation rate will only be determined at the end of $4^{\text{th}}$ business days prior to Segment Initiation Date (Lock In Date) and may vary from one Segment to another.
